mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(customer_group) AS keyCode, TRIM(customer_group) AS keyName FROM t_sr_strategy WHERE tab_type = 'active' AND strategy_class = '重点客群' AND is_deleted = 0 AND customer_group IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(customer_group) != '' ORDER BY keyName

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth,
s.channel AS channel, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.strategy_id) AS strategyCount, SUM(s.original_cust) AS originalCust, SUM(s.push_count) AS pushCount, SUM(s.usage_count) AS usageCount, SUM(s.reach_count) AS reachCount, SUM(s.target_conv_num) AS targetConvNum, SUM(s.product_conv_num) AS productConvNum, SUM(s.expected_income) AS expectedIncome, SUM(s.actual_income) AS actualIncome, SUM(s.reject_count) AS rejectCount FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap s WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m')
, s.channel , s.big_category, s.small_category
ORDER BY statMonth

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, b.biz_name AS bizName, SUM(b.count) AS capacity FROM t_sr_strategy_biz_capacity b JOIN t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap s ON s.strategy_id = b.strategy_id AND s.tab_type = b.tab_type AND s.city_id <=> b.city_id AND s.county_id <=> b.county_id AND DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(b.stat_date, '%Y-%m') WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.tab_type = 'active' AND b.biz_name != '全部' AND GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m'), s.big_category, s.small_category, b.biz_name ORDER BY statMonth, capacity DESC
